rootCause.contract: unchanged; fault slash remains strictly before faultDeadline and release remains available at/after the deadline

oldTests.disputes: relative evm_increaseTime(deadline - latest - 2) left time for transaction submission/estimation and full-suite fixture work; the resolve transaction could be mined at the deadline, so the nominal D-1 slash was rejected
oldTests.vault: relative evm_increaseTime(97) after markFault(deadline = pre-mark latest + 100) did not pin the target receipt; full-suite execution could mine slash at or after D and hit AgentMarketplaceV2.sol:144 FaultWindowClosed

correctedClockEvidence.method: evm_setNextBlockTimestamp immediately before each boundary transaction; explicit gasLimit skips revert-prone estimateGas; failed receipts are read back by transactionHash

disputes.Dminus1: resolveFaultReview receipt block timestamp is asserted equal to faultReviewDeadline - 1; genuine positive late slash remains successful
disputes.D: resolveFaultReview is sent with gasLimit and its mined receipt status is asserted 0 with block timestamp equal to faultReviewDeadline
disputes.Dplus1: releaseFaultReview receipt block timestamp is asserted equal to faultReviewDeadline + 1 and succeeds

vault.Dminus1: slashAndRelease receipt block timestamp is asserted equal to faultDeadline - 1 and disposition becomes slashed/released
vault.D: slashAndRelease is sent with gasLimit and its mined receipt status is asserted 0 with block timestamp equal to faultDeadline
vault.Dplus1: releaseFault receipt block timestamp is asserted equal to faultDeadline + 1 and disposition becomes released
